== Biography ==

The Princess is addressed as "your Highness" and referred to as the "girl Ruler" of Oz. She hosts a birthday party to which Dorothy is a guest, and greets Dorothy with warmth when Dorothy arrives, prompting Dorothy to hug and kiss her. The Princess asks Dorothy who she imagines mixed up the roads that started Dorothy wandering toward Oz, suggesting she herself had a hand in the matter, though she answers Dorothy's question about this only with "Didn't I?" — leaving her own role deliberately unconfirmed.

When Dorothy presents the shaggy man at the throne, calling him "my friend, the shaggy man, who owns the Love Magnet," the Princess receives him graciously, telling him he is welcome to Oz. Her manner throughout is described as gracious, and she is shown ruling from a throne within her palace.

== Relationships ==

'''[[King Bud of Noland]]''' — a family tie is suggested by the records, though the passage describing a sibling bond names the Princess Fluff as King Bud's sister rather than this Princess, so the connection may not concern her at all.

'''[[Dorothy]]''' — friend. The two speak directly at the birthday gathering, with the Princess questioning Dorothy about who had mixed up the roads toward Oz.

'''[[Johnny Dooit]]''' — an acquaintance is suggested by a record of him thanking the Princess for her hospitality, though this exchange does not appear directly among the passages here.

'''[[THE shaggy man]]''' — acquaintance. She receives him graciously at her throne after Dorothy presents him, telling him he is welcome to Oz.

'''[[Wizard]]''' — an acquaintance is suggested by the records, though no direct exchange between them appears in the accounts here.
